Lina (ProdOps): 15 mins to all-hands. Heads-up: Stage-1 camera encoder temp spike, encoder is throttling. Evan, status? :thermometer_face:
Evan (AV Tech): Seeing CPU @ 96% and warning fan RPM low. Trying a soft restart on encoder-1. If that fails we have backup encoder-2 hot on standby.
alert-bot: encoder-1 thermal warning generated (host=stage-1, cpu=96%, temp=92C)
Priya (SRE): If encoder goes down, recorder service should failover to the other node. I'm prepping the failover script now.
Tom (Eng): Also flagging that the VOD upload lambda timed out yesterday. Might need to increase retries if we end up writing a local buffer.
Lina (ProdOps): Plan B: swap to encoder-2, switch recording to local buffer, start the backup Zoom room (room B). Maria ok with a 10-minute pause to switch?
Maria (CEO): Pause is fine. Don't rush — stable stream is priority.
Evan (AV Tech): Soft restart completed, fan spiked back up, temp dropping slowly. Running a stress test clip.
Evan (AV Tech): Stress run shows consistent 60fps for 2 minutes, temp now stable at 68C. I'll keep an eye.
Priya (SRE): Deploying a quick healthcheck alert for encoder temp > 85C to escalate automatically. Command I'm running: ```kubectl apply -f k8s/encoder-temp-alert.yaml```
Tom (Eng): For the VOD fallback: I'll create an mounts script to write segments locally and kick off async upload. Pseudocode: ```ffmpeg -f segment -segment_time 60 -strftime 1 out-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.mp4 && aws s3 cp --recursive ./out-*.mp4 s3://redwood-vods/```
Lina (ProdOps): Good. Evan, if temp climbs again, flip to encoder-2 and post here. We'll announce the 10-min delay in #general.
Evan (AV Tech): Copy. Preparing switch plan: encoder-2 on standby, NDI failover ready. Hotkey mapped.
alert-bot: zoom-backup room created: https://zoom.company/roomB (host=prodops)
Lina (ProdOps): Slide deck will be visible but we're holding on presenter flow until switch is confirmed. Q&A moderation: keep sending live questions here, we'll triage into product and engineering threads.
Maria (CEO): Thanks team. Could ops folks DM me a short postmortem note after so we can discuss long-term fixes in the next exec sync?
Priya (SRE): Will file a ticket with timeline + proposed mitigations (add UPS for encoder rack, replace fans, implement local segment retry).
Tom (Eng): Also adding an alert to our infra board: increase lambda retries + implement exponential backoff for VOD uploads.
Lina (ProdOps): Alright all, encoder holding. Proceeding with the all-hands in 6. If anything degrades we pause slides and move people to Zoom room B. End of live ops thread — Q&A continues in meeting.
